messages.subject: Car detailing services
messages.body_plain:
Hey neighbors! 🚗✨

We’re a mobile car detailing team now serving our area — full interior, exterior & engine bay service right at your doorstep.

No hassle, no waiting — and  don’t pay until you’re fully satisfied.

Slots are filling fast this week, so feel free to send your car model and details for a quick quote or reach out at 386-260-8235
